at.description: Timestamp of the stored line with nanosecond precision.

labels.description: Stream labels of the line; untrusted data.

fields.description: Every field of the log line complete; a name the line repeats holds the list of all its values in line order (named in repeated_fields). A raw line has no fields. Untrusted data.

line.description: The complete stored line with authentication secrets replaced.

repeated_fields.description: Fields whose name the line repeated, as dotted paths.

redacted_fields.description: Secret fields replaced by <redacted>, as dotted paths.

secrets_redacted.description: Authentication secrets inside a text value were replaced.
